C x.ss-state-limitations EX WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; State in every report that static review is not a penetration test and may miss runtime, infrastructure, business-logic, authorization-bypass, deployment and dynamic-exploitation issues. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-concrete OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Report concrete risks in the context of actual exposure, not generic advice. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-distinguish OL WF-020 MUST ;; Distinguish confirmed findings from items needing verification (NEEDS VERIFICATION). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Assign severity from exploitability, reachability, impact and context, never from a pattern, OWASP category or raw CVSS alone. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.ss-dev-secret OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not suppress a real secret because it sits in a Development file. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-no-unneeded OL GOV-013,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require security mechanisms the project does not need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.ss-effective-authz OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Evaluate effective authorization including global and fallback policies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.ss-tool-independence OL WF-021,WF-020 MUST ;; The scan works without any specific MCP server, analyzer, agent or commercial scanner; tools are evidence: inspect code, confirm reachability and relevance, report with appropriate confidence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.ss-surfaces OL WF-007,WF-009 MUST ;; Inspect which surfaces exist and skip irrelevant checks rather than reporting them as failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.ss-select-scope OL WF-007 MUST ;; Full pre-release or requested audits review all applicable layers; targeted changes start with affected layers and expand across security boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-owasp-taxonomy EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; OWASP categories are an awareness taxonomy: map only when it genuinely fits. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-severity-factors OL WF-020 MUST ;; Weigh exploitability, exposure, privileges, affected data/capability, blast radius, exploitation reliability and compensating controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-severity-scale EX WF-020 DEFINITION ;; Severity scale Critical (sparingly), High, Medium, Low, Info (hardening observation). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-false-positives OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Not automatically findings: missing attribute under a secure fallback, bare authorization when authentication alone is intended, allow-any-origin on a public non-credentialed API, non-security MD5/SHA1, platform encryption sufficing, fake credentials, secure framework defaults. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.ss-not-safe OL SEC-001,SEC-010,SEC-005,SEC-009,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Not automatically safe: secrets in appsettings.Development.json, sensitive values logged at Debug, client route guards, hidden buttons, CORS as authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-finding-fields EX WF-020 MUST ;; Name technique skills instead of copying guidance into the report; each confirmed finding states severity, location, title, evidence, why it is a risk, impact, smallest remediation and OWASP category when applicable. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.ss-needs-verification OL WF-020 MUST ;; Label uncertain items NEEDS VERIFICATION. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-report-template EX WF-020,WF-009 DEFAULT ;; Report shape: Scope, Limitations, severity Summary, Findings, Layer Results. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ss-layer-status EX WF-009 MUST ;; Layer status is PASS, FINDINGS, NOT APPLICABLE or NOT CHECKED. ;; = ;; none ;; Vocabulary differs from WF-009.
C wf009.ss-no-unchecked-pass OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Never PASS for an uninspected layer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.ss-remediation OL GOV-013,GOV-014,SEC-006,SEC-008 MUST_NOT ;; Recommend the smallest secure change; not unneeded auth systems, custom crypto, blanket field encryption, attributes on every action under a global policy, libraries to satisfy the scan or disabling functionality a scanner cannot understand. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ss-completion OL WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; Complete when applicable layers were inspected, findings carry evidence, uncertain items are labelled, severity reflects actual risk and no layer is PASS unchecked. ;; = ;; none ;;

C gov014.scan-no-upgrade OL GOV-014,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not upgrade packages during a scan unless asked. ;; = ;; Asked. ;;
C wf020.scan-dependency-context OL WF-020 MUST ;; Distinguish production from development/build and direct from transitive dependency findings; dev-only issues still matter but differ in runtime impact. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.scan-any-file OL SEC-001,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not ignore appsettings.Development.json automatically; fake values may be ignored or Info; UserSecretsId is not a secret. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.scan-mechanism OL SEC-002 MUST ;; Real values come from the chosen secret mechanism. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.scan-parameterize OL SEC-004 DEFAULT ;; Prefer ORM LINQ, parameterized SQL, interpolation-aware raw-SQL APIs and ADO.NET/micro-ORM parameters. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scan-no-pattern-findings OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report patterns without context (LINQ predicates with user input, query parameters as SSRF without host influence, ordinary template binding as XSS, returned entities without inspecting serialized fields). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-command-exec EX SEC-003 PREFER ;; Prefer APIs separating executable and arguments and constrain input for command execution. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.scan-path-boundary EX SEC-003,SEC-015 MUST ;; Normalize and verify user-controlled paths stay inside the intended root. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec008.scan-crypto OL SEC-008,SEC-016,SEC-001 MUST ;; Flag security-sensitive MD5/SHA1/ECB, hardcoded keys, custom password hashing, home-grown protocols; non-security checksums are fine; passwords use established hashers, never reversible encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.scan-effective-policy OL SEC-006,WF-020 MUST ;; Determine actual authorization behaviour (fallback, attributes, policies, roles/claims, resource authorization) before reporting. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.scan-anonymous OL SEC-006,WF-012 MUST ;; Confirm public surfaces are intentional; a public endpoint is not automatically a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.scan-idor OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Verify ownership, tenant or permission checks where identifiers could expose others' data; client-side filtering is not authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.scan-token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Check Bearer/OIDC validation; do not demand every TokenValidationParameters property or a universal ClockSkew; flag intentionally disabled validation without reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.scan-frontend OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Route guards and hidden/disabled buttons are UX; verify the backend protects sensitive operations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.scan-cors OL SEC-009 MUST ;; CORS is a browser-origin policy, not authorization; look for broad or credentialed untrusted origins and leaked environment origins; a wildcard is fine for a public non-credentialed API. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.scan-csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; Review CSRF protection for state-changing operations when browser credentials are sent automatically. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.scan-tls OL SEC-007 MUST ;; Review disabled certificate validation, accept-all callbacks and plain HTTP; account for TLS termination; missing HTTPS redirection is not automatically a vulnerability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-rate-limiting EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Consider rate limiting where abuse realistically matters (login, password reset, expensive anonymous or resource-intensive endpoints); not required everywhere. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C sec010.scan-logging OL SEC-010,WF-012 MUST ;; Check logs for never-log data, PII per requirements; Debug/Trace is not a boundary; no demand to log every successful request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec008.scan-data-at-rest OL SEC-008,SEC-016 DEFAULT ;; Protection by requirement: one-way hashing for passwords, hashing for verification tokens, protected storage for retrievable secrets, platform/database encryption, Data Protection for temporary payloads (not universal database encryption). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.scan-fail-open OL SEC-013 MUST ;; Investigate catch blocks that let privileged operations continue (fail-open). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.scan-swallowed OL SEC-013,API-007 MUST_NOT ;; Security-relevant failures must not silently become success. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.scan-retry OL RUN-016,RUN-019 MUST ;; Retried state-changing operations can duplicate effects; caller cancellation is never a transient failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scan-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Judge real exploitability of unbounded resources before rating. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.scan-startup OL SEC-014 MUST ;; Review startup/configuration failure for silent authentication disablement, plaintext fallback or allow-all. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.scan-unexpected OL API-007,API-008 MUST ;; Unexpected exceptions follow centralized handling and reveal nothing sensitive. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.scan-design-review EX WF-020,WF-012 MUST ;; Name security-sensitive workflows (tenant isolation, workflow abuse, privilege escalation, idempotency abuse, multi-step authorization) as threat-modeling/manual-review candidates instead of claiming the scan proves them secure. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.scan-report-format EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Finding format: [SEVERITY] path:line — title, OWASP, Evidence, Impact, Remediation. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf020.scan-needs-verification OL WF-020 MUST ;; Report incomplete evidence as NEEDS VERIFICATION stating what effective behaviour depends on. ;; = ;; Evidence incomplete. ;;
C wf020.scan-no-invent-exploit OL WF-020,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Never invent exploitability the code does not establish. ;; = ;; none ;;

C dep012.sw-ui-baseline OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; The developer-facing requirement is the interactive Swagger UI (Swashbuckle), not a standalone raw OpenAPI endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-config-layer EX ARC-012 DEFAULT ;; Keep Swagger configuration in the entry-point/composition code. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C dep012.sw-not-addopenapi OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; Do not make AddOpenApi()/MapOpenApi() the default when the requirement is Swagger UI testing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-launch-urls EX WF-006 MUST_NOT ;; Keep application URLs consistent with the launch profile; never a launch URL pointing to HTTPS on an HTTP-only port. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api016.sw-full-pipeline OL API-016,API-003 MUST ;; Consider the whole pipeline when listing responses; never 201 for a 200 endpoint or 204 for one returning a body; describe ProblemDetails contracts where useful. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.sw-no-internal OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger examples contain no internal exception types, stack traces, SQL, connection strings or paths. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-auth-metadata OL API-016 MUST ;; Add security definitions only when the API really uses authentication; never apply requirements globally to anonymous endpoints or add a scheme because a package is installed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-bearer-ui EX DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; Add a Bearer scheme so authenticated endpoints can be exercised from Swagger UI. ;; = ;; Bearer used. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sw-descriptions EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Describe consumer-relevant preconditions, idempotency, pagination/filtering and outcomes, not restated names; XML comments optional for public contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.sw-multiple-docs EX API-016,API-015 MUST_NOT ;; Use multiple Swagger documents only for a real contract separation (versions, public vs internal). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api014.sw-client-contracts OL API-014,API-016,WF-016 MUST ;; When the contract feeds client generation treat breaking schema changes seriously, keep metadata accurate and review generated-client diffs. ;; = ;; Client generation. ;;
C x.sw-explicit-contracts EX API-016,API-014 AVOID ;; Avoid anonymous response shapes / anonymous objects as long-lived contracts; use explicit request/response contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf006.sw-verify OL WF-006,WF-005,API-016 MUST ;; After API changes verify controller behaviour, integration tests and metadata; start the API when startup changed, open the Development Swagger UI and exercise endpoints when meaningful. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.sw-preserve OL TST-010 MUST ;; Preserve newly verified behaviour as tests (verify step 4). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.sw-anti-list OL API-016,API-017,GOV-013,DEP-012 AVOID ;; Avoid metadata disagreeing with runtime, public Swagger UI without a reason, global auth on anonymous endpoints and a second competing documentation stack without need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-not-test-substitute EX TST-002 MUST_NOT ;; Swagger is not a substitute for integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

C x.tm-compact-surface EX - MUST_NOT ;; Keep the always-loaded surface compact; do not move path/workflow policy into it to simplify loading nor always-needed policy out of it to save tokens. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.

27 NN ;; Heading.

C wf003.v-scope-risk OL WF-003 MUST ;; Produce completion evidence at the scope and risk of the change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-configured-tooling OL WF-007,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require optional tooling the repository has not configured. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-inspect OL WF-004,GOV-014 MUST ;; Review the final changed-file set and diff before choosing checks: scope match, no unrelated refactoring, no accidental artifacts, no secrets/credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.v-probes-before-removal OL TST-010 MUST ;; Remove temporary diagnostics/probes only after behaviour they uniquely verified is preserved as maintained tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-affected-areas OL WF-004,WF-007 MUST ;; Determine affected areas (backend, frontend, both, documentation-only without unrelated builds). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf005.v-build OL WF-005 MUST ;; Build the affected solution/projects (frontend via frontend.commands); a build failure means the implementation is not complete. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-no-restore EX WF-005 MUST_NOT ;; Do not use --no-restore unless restore is known to be complete. ;; = ;; Restore known complete. ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf005.v-tests OL WF-005 MUST ;; Run tests covering the changed area; investigate every newly failing relevant test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-test-scope EX WF-005,TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Small solutions run the full suite; large ones run affected projects first, then the broader suite the risk requires. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf006.v-smoke OL WF-006 DEFAULT ;; For new runnable applications or substantial startup/configuration/persistence/full-stack changes verify Development startup and key composition surfaces; a build alone does not prove runtime composition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst010.v-preserve OL TST-010 MUST ;; Preserve behaviour uniquely demonstrated by an ad-hoc probe in maintained automated tests before completion unless equivalent coverage exists; builds/compiler/formatter/analysis need no new tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-architecture OL WF-007,WF-001,ARC-001 MUST ;; When the change touches boundaries check the rules under 1-architecture and run check-architecture.mjs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst008.v-seed-check OL PST-008 MUST ;; When domain/persistence changes affect seeded entities confirm the persistence.workflow seed step was done. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-skip-docs OL WF-007 MUST_NOT ;; Skip the architecture audit for documentation-only or unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-format OL WF-007,GOV-013,WF-021 MUST ;; Run configured formatting/analysis; do not add a formatter/analyzer dependency just to verify; analyzer output needs context. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-dependency-security OL WF-007,DEP-004,SEC-001 MUST ;; For dependency or security-sensitive changes run vulnerability/audit commands and inspect secrets, authorization, raw SQL, CORS/TLS, sensitive logging and certificate validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.v-scan-not-always OL WF-007,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; A full security-scan is not needed for every small business-logic change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf004.v-final-diff OL WF-004,TST-010,ARC-001 MUST ;; Review the final diff after fixes for accidental unrelated edits, architecture drift and manually verified behaviour never preserved as a test. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.v-diff-hygiene EX WF-004 MUST ;; Final diff has no commented-out code, temporary logging, unintended TODO/FIXME markers or stale temporary tests/scripts. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov003.v-spec-drift OL GOV-003,GOV-021 MUST ;; No unapproved drift from SPECIFICATION.md/CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md and no stale code/tests/docs/config after a settings change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run010.v-usings OL RUN-010 MUST ;; Remove unused/redundant usings in every created or modified C# file (incl. implicit/global duplicates unless needed); verify changed files; no repository-wide cleanup. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf008.v-fix-retry OL WF-008,WF-014 MUST ;; On failure identify it, make the smallest fix, rerun affected checks (and builds/tests when code changed) until green or user input is required; build-fix for non-trivial repair; never hide a known failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.v-report OL WF-009 MUST ;; Report only what was run (builds, tests, runtime smoke, architecture, formatting, security/dependency, diff review) using NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE rather than implying unchecked areas passed. ;; = ;; none ;;
